title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
goal: Sum the minimum value of every subarray modulo 1000000007.
strategy: Assign each subarray to one minimum occurrence using asymmetric equal-value boundaries. Popping a monotonic stack reveals the previous strictly smaller index and the next smaller-or-equal index, giving the number of subarrays owned by that occurrence.
